about: the optics tests' plate_marble (tests/optics/gen_object.py) under optics/rigs/backlit.json, framed to the arc of the original's shot 37 (S3 review: compose as the film does)

camera.why: our choice: a 100 mm lens at f/11, looking 0 degrees down; placed and focused so the object's upper edge is the arc of the original's shot 37 (spec/shots.json), the shot of this rig's first look target

ground_why: our choice: a blue ground behind the warm glow (the lantern on a blue sky of shot 37)
render_why: 256 bounces: light crosses 4 mm of marble (about 10 mean free paths) by around a hundred scatterings
mix_why: our choice (S3 preview): the glow leads, the front fill only keeps the face from going black
